Moon Faire: story pictures to paint

November 14. The extra pictures the chosen story, "The fire that would not end", needs beyond the nine walking places and the map. All twelve are painted and in the game's folders.

  • You painted all twelve on November 14. Each is shown here as it now sits in the game's folders. The four fight places kept the horizon, the moon and the open ground of their guides. The prompts are kept under each picture.
  • No witches in any of them. The game puts its 3D witches, fair folk and foes on top of paintings, so they always look like themselves. The one exception is a pair of hands.
  • Three kinds. Fight places are painted from a guide, like your moor clearing, so fighters' feet sit on the ground. Story pictures fill the screen with one line of words under them. Two are small changes to paintings you already have.
  • Fights are seen level in all four fight places, like your own moor clearing.
  • Claude Fable 5.2 wrote what each picture shows and laid out the fight guides, through your key ($4.58).

The last fight and the ending (F5-a to F5-d).

The green lines are the guide. What matters for the game is that the horizon, the moon and the open ground sit where the guide has them, and they do. The painter made some of the stonework taller than the guide, which harms nothing.
